summary: Backups and restores are run by the installer from the installation host. Backups contain the database and the secret key that decrypts credentials, so store them encrypted and limit access to AAP admins; always back up and restore with the same PostgreSQL and AAP versions.
questions: Do AAP backups contain the SECRET_KEY?
Can I restore an AAP backup to a different version?
Where should AAP backups be stored?
